india_trends.title: Regional rural banks told to speed up tech adoption
india_trends.summary: Regional rural banks are urged to accelerate modern technology adoption and digital services. Their net profit reached an all-time high of ₹10,176 crore in FY26. Sponsor banks must handhold RRBs in strengthening their IT infrastructure. The total business of all 28 RRBs has now crossed ₹13.5 lakh cr

india_trends.title: EAC moots consolidation to create a few large banks
india_trends.summary: India needs to consolidate banks into a few large entities. This consolidation aims to meet rising credit needs for Viksit Bharat by 2047. Banks will increasingly focus on data-driven customer experiences and AI automation. The banking sector has seen significant positive changes since 2014. Future

india_trends.title: Uttarakhand government approves 25-year power procurement from Adani Power
india_trends.summary: The Uttarakhand Cabinet approved a 25-year power purchase agreement with Adani Power for 1,320 MW of coal-based electricity at ₹5.746 per unit. The power will come from a plant being set up in Chhattisgarh and is expected to be supplied to the state from FY30.
